opportunities.concept: Alexander sheds his disguise, steps out in ducal regalia, and declares he is coming home and bringing his wife home
opportunities.why_promising: The hook 'Enough hiding' (62000-62800) is a strong opener, and the clip runs 62000-98000ms (36000ms) to an unresolved vow about the wife. The 'buried three years ago' line within the clip gives the mystery of his survival, and the wife's situation stays unanswered.

opportunities.concept: Loyalists strike the cathedral entrance guards and the operation moves inside toward the chapel
opportunities.why_promising: The clip runs 29800-82200ms (52400ms). It opens on the sentry's sharp 'Stop!' (29800-30600), which is an immediate hook, and it covers the attack and the 'Tell the Duke' report. It ends on the unresolved order 'Secure the chapel' (80500-82200), and the chapel's outcome is not shown.

opportunities.concept: Loyalists in an alley count the royal guards and confirm the east gate, then the cart strike proceeds and the message is sent to the Duke
opportunities.why_promising: The clip runs 18300-49200ms (30900ms). It opens on the urgent 'Six at the front' (18300-19900), and the guard counts and east-gate exchange are all inside the clip. It ends on the unresolved 'Tell the Duke' (48200-49200), so the viewer is left wondering whether the message reaches its target.

opportunities.concept: A loyalist kneels and greets Alexander as Your Grace, and Alexander orders the chapel secured and vows to bring his wife home
opportunities.why_promising: The clip runs 75800-98000ms (22200ms). The hook 'Your Grace' (75800-77200) opens on the reveal of his rank, and the clip includes the command and the 'No more hiding' defiance. It ends on the unresolved wife vow (95000-98000), which is a distinct angle from the full transformation clip.
